answer: A sybil farm runs many identities from one host, so make each identity prove independent vantage. At a random minute, every agent reports the arrival times of shared beacon pulses from its own connection, like watchers across a meadow timing one bell. Reports are sealed in a cipher commitment before reveal, so no clone can copy a peer. Honest agents on separate networks show uncorrelated jitter, but clones sharing one island of infrastructure share millisecond jitter, so their reports merge into one counted identity. Faking diversity means renting separate networks per clone, no discount.
